def load() -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    path = "data/legal/input/csn-data-book-2024-csv/CSVs/2024_CSN_Report_Count.csv"
    # First two rows are title and blank; last rows are source notes
    df = pd.read_csv(path, skiprows=1, dtype=str)
    # Keep only proper data rows where Year is 4 digits
    df = df.rename(columns={df.columns[0]: "year", df.columns[1]: "reportCount"})
    df = df[df["year"].str.match(r"^\d{4}$", na=False)].copy()
    df["year"] = df["year"].astype(int)
    df["reportCount"] = (
        df["reportCount"].str.replace(",", "", regex=False).astype(float).astype(int)
    )
    return df

def load() -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    path = "data/legal/input/csn-data-book-2024-csv/CSVs/2024_CSN_Identity_Theft_Reports_by_Age.csv"
    df = pd.read_csv(path, skiprows=1, dtype=str)
    df = df.rename(columns={df.columns[0]: "ageRange", df.columns[1]: "reports"})
    # Keep only rows that look like age ranges (exclude notes/source)
    df = df[df["ageRange"].notna() & df["reports"].notna()].copy()
    df = df[df["ageRange"].str.contains(r"Under|\d", regex=True, na=False)].copy()
    df["reports"] = df["reports"].str.replace(",", "", regex=False).astype(int)
    return df

def process(reportCount, identityTheftByAge) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    # 2024 age distribution for 40+
    age40plus = identityTheftByAge[identityTheftByAge["ageRange"].isin(["40 - 49", "50 - 59", "60 - 69", "70 - 79", "80 and Over"])].copy()
    ageKnownTotal = identityTheftByAge["reports"].sum()
    share40plusAmongKnown = age40plus["reports"].sum() / ageKnownTotal

    # Use 2007 total reports (all categories) and assume same share
    total2007 = int(reportCount.loc[reportCount["year"] == 2007, "reportCount"].iloc[0])
    est2007 = total2007 * share40plusAmongKnown

    rounded = int(round(est2007 / 1000.0) * 1000)

    return pd.DataFrame([
        {
            "totalReports2007": total2007,
            "share40plus2024": share40plusAmongKnown,
            "estimatedReports2007Age40plus": est2007,
            "roundedNearestThousand": rounded,
        }
    ])
